paragraphs: R' Yitzchak bar Chakula. See the entry R' Yitzchak ben Elazar.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied heading has חקולא, conventionally Chakula; an earlier heading audit had חלקיא. The target is ben Elazar, retaining ben rather than the heading’s bar. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
